attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL9) with AMQP-over-TLS as the only client listener, mandatory client-certificate authentication against a cluster-dedicated CA, and a management interface bound to each node's private IP and firewall-restricted to the cluster subnet. Each node was then sequentially rebooted via the mandatory restart protocol, with boot-id changes and full cluster/TLS/management recovery proven on every node.
